newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares close near high, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares close near high, more gains seen.

text.p: Swedish shares ended ahead on Friday with two indices at highs, fuelled by gains in rate-sensitive shares and a continued rally in clothing retailer Hennes & Maurtiz.
The bourse's general index closed up 0.34 percent at 2,063.97 after turnover of 3.6 billion crowns.
The banking sector index rose 2.65 percent, helped by a six-percent surge by insurance company Skandia.
Skandia leapt 11 crowns to 182 after the company said Lars-Eric Petersson had been appointed president and chief executive officer of the group, replacing Bjorn Wolrath.
Rate-sensitive shares were seen staying in demand for the next couple of sessions.
Telecoms group Ericsson fell 2.50 crowns to 168 and drug company Astra rose two crowns to 279.

H&M soared 32 crowns to 801, adding to its 92-crown rally on Thursday after the firm reported a pre-tax profit for a nine month period of 1.02 billion crowns, a 52 percent increase over the same period a year earlier.
Demand for cyclical shares was subdued and the forestry sector index fell 0.73 percent. MoDo fell 1.50 crowns to 180.
